scope: initial derive-first audit over consolidated course/state/code/presentation evidence

findings.title: Fixed-area course canvas family
findings.result: All 45 normalized headers have product 1024. Applying the promoted 4x coarse-grid / 256x world transform yields 16,384 coarse sectors and 67,108,864 square world units for every course.
findings.falsifier: Any direct runtime/materialization check on an unsampled course that violates the promoted transform.
findings.next_action: Use the six-shape representative set before attempting corpus-wide runtime validation.

findings.title: Resource cursor is the resource-list start

equations: exactly one byte follows the terminator

findings.falsifier: A canonical stream violating any equation.
findings.next_action: Promote the field to resource-list start/boundary semantics; leave the post-terminator byte separately unnamed.

findings.title: Only six course dimension families occur
findings.falsifier: A canonical decoded stream with another normalized dimension pair.
findings.next_action: Use one representative per family for geometry-sensitive validation.

findings.title: Track-kind resource scaffolds
findings.falsifier: A canonical course of the same track kind violating its exact common prefix.
findings.next_action: Treat the stable prefix as a base-resource scaffold candidate; do not assign resource semantics from order alone.

findings.title: Universal resource core

result.exception_to_resource_2_second: Downer places resource 18 second and resource 2 third

findings.falsifier: A canonical course missing resource 1 or 2.
findings.next_action: Prioritize resources 1 and 2 as cross-course semantic anchors.

findings.title: Compression and resource count do not classify track kind

result.notable_counterexample: Dragster has the lowest compression ratio in the entire corpus.

findings.next_action: Do not use RNC compression ratio, decoded size, or resource count alone as semantic classifiers.

findings.title: Minimal geometry stress corpus

result.policy: Keep Dragster as the instrumented 256x4 baseline; for each other dimension family choose the highest-resource-count representative.

findings.next_action: Use this set for first cross-shape presentation/geometry generalization.

findings.title: Regional racer slot spacing is preserved
findings.falsifier: A recovered homolog relation contradicting the repeated spacing.
findings.next_action: Use these deltas as search constraints for adjacent unnamed racer-state relations without naming them from spacing alone.

findings.title: Low-bank symbol mirrors must canonicalize to CPU banks for joins

result.rule: 00-3F ROM code symbols canonicalize to 80-BF mirror banks before structural-census joining

findings.next_action: Keep canonical code-address normalization in all future cross-source tooling.

findings.title: Observed racer presentation records share one container equation
findings.falsifier: A newly recovered frame in the same family violating the equation.
findings.next_action: Use the 4-byte header plus u16-word boundary as a fixed constraint for differential packed-word decoding.
